sections.name: MarketGate
sections.note: The weekly market's cement road: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstStalls
sections.note: The first row of stalls: run under, or jump into an awning and bounce along.

sections.name: Hens
sections.note: A flock of hens across the road: jump them.

sections.name: Basket
sections.note: The hens' basket: jump it.

sections.name: HighAwnings
sections.note: Four stalls: a feather high over their awnings for a bounce and a double jump.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: Clothesline
sections.note: A clothesline across the road: slide.

sections.name: PotsBasket
sections.note: Pots, then the hens' basket.

sections.name: Flocks
sections.note: Two flocks of hens.

sections.name: StallsHens
sections.note: A row of stalls, then hens after it.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: ClothesBasketPots
sections.note: Clothesline, the hens' basket, pots.

sections.name: LongAwnings
sections.note: A long row of stalls: bounce along all of them, a feather at the top.

sections.name: FakeOut
sections.note: Pots; the rooster knocks a hens' basket into the road; a clothesline.

sections.name: FlocksAwnings
sections.note: Hens, a row of stalls, hens.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: CrowdedRoad
sections.note: Hens, pots, a clothesline, the hens' basket.

sections.name: LastAwnings
sections.note: The last row of stalls.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: Hens, a clothesline, pots, the hens' basket, hens: everything once more.

sections.name: StallsAgain
sections.note: Stalls, then a flock after them.

sections.name: ChilliLane2
sections.note: A chilli.

sections.name: BasketsPots
sections.note: Two hens' baskets, pots, a clothesline.

sections.name: LastRow
sections.note: One more row of stalls.

sections.name: MarketEnd
sections.note: The market thins out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 700 m.
